slides.texte_overlay:
6 traits a man must have
before dating

1. He keeps his place clean:

Dishes done.
Bed made.
No surprises at the door.

2. He has his own friends:

A life that doesn't
depend on one person.

3. He can handle a "no":

No sulking.
No pressure.
Respect, then move on.

4. He can cook a real meal:

Not fancy.
Just real.

5. He has things to talk about:

History, art, travel.
He keeps learning.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. He has things to talk about:

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
6. He keeps his word:

If he says he'll call,
he calls.
